commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Sandbox authored fragments and review visuals at any origin
commits.body:
Fragments and review slide visuals run author script with 'unsafe-inline'.
Their sandboxed iframes already give that script an opaque origin, but a
direct top-level visit to /f/... or /reviews/{id}/visual/{slide} ran it on
the app origin, where it could read pages carrying the review mutation token.

Both handlers now share one policy that adds the CSP sandbox directive with
allow-scripts only, so the document is opaque-origin wherever it loads. The
existing connect-src 'none' and frame-ancestors 'self' are kept, and tests
assert the header on both handlers through the security middleware.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Check authored content runs on an opaque origin in the browser
commits.body:
The interactive fragment now also loads an image asset from its own package.
One test clicks it inside its iframe and after a direct top-level visit,
checking that the script and the image still work and that the document's
origin is opaque both times. A second opens a review slide visual directly
and checks the sandbox directive and the opaque origin. Both tests fail
against the policy without the sandbox directive.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Explain why authored script never runs on the app origin
commits.body:
A new visual-implementation slide, in the Failure boundaries section,
shows both ways to reach a fragment or review visual: framed in an app
page, or opened directly. Both routes send one authored-content policy, so
the author script always runs on origin null, away from pages carrying the
review token. The slide also shows a pre-existing surprise: fonts served
from the app's own URL don't load under the sandbox, so authors should
embed data: fonts. Items hold exact evidence for the policy, both routes,
the unit and browser tests, and the strict app-page policy.

Only new records were added; existing shared slides and Items are
untouched while the evidence relay is running.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Author the review deck for sandboxed authored content
commits.body:
One before/after slide shows the change: a framed fragment already ran on
origin null, but opening the same URL directly ran its script on the app
origin. Now the response's own sandbox directive makes it origin null too.
Old-side lines sit on the before Item and new-side lines on the after Item,
which also points to the living slide. The server and browser test lines
sit on two proof Items. The deck explains all 104 changed lines against
feature/review-ux-improvements, with no stale references or overlaps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Close the living evidence gaps for the sandboxed-content slide
commits.body:
The living slide's Items now also cover the policy's trailing blank line
and the replaced old-side lines in the fragment test and fixture, so every
line this branch changes has a living owner. The policy Item also links,
with a pinned rationale, to the criterion that deck HTML slides are
sandboxed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.author: trevor@twentyideas.com <trevor@twentyideas.com>
commits.subject: Keep deleted-line evidence in the review deck, not the living slide
commits.body:
The previous commit pinned replaced old-side test and fixture lines on
living Items. Reconcile reports those references as newly stale at HEAD,
because the lines no longer exist, and a living deck should only reference
current code. The review deck already owns those deleted lines, so the two
old-side living records are removed. The current-code evidence, including
the policy's blank line, and the criterion link are kept.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
